static_traits.name: 陈艾米
static_traits.educational_background: Planning to enroll at the University of Kentucky
static_traits.family_status: 有两个兄弟；与兄弟关系支持性Good
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的家人和朋友，但对向他们表达大学Anxiety持犹豫态度
static_traits.medical_history: not yet出现类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 思维与表达清晰，能具体描述担忧；语气偏消极，倾向灾难化与预测not yet来；配合度Good，愿意尝试小步行动；Self-doubt较多（如“我not确定”“not够”）

basic_info.main_problem: 对即将进入肯塔基大学感到Anxiety，认为会因工作量过大而表现not佳。
basic_info.core_demands: 在入学前处理我的Anxiety和消极想法。
growth_experiences: 在High school曾有几次面对项目或考试时，最初认为自己without法完成或考not好，但最终通过坚持学习计划与提醒自己“我曾经做得很好”而顺利完成并取得Good结果；这类经历增强了她在结构化学习与时间管理上的有效性。

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough大学的学习
我without法应对高强度的Academic pressure

special_situations.event: 思考大学课程的工作量（大量阅读与作业），并回忆在读Student对课堂强度的描述
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果大学课程强度很高，我就一定会被压垮、without法跟上
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前制定学习计划，并向在读Student寻求建议以试图掌控not确定性
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: In university I will do even worse, because I will be overwhelmed by work.

special_situations.event: Began preparing university applications, accompanied by rising pressure to 'maintain academic excellence'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能维持与High school同等的优秀表现，就说明我失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reinforcement时间管理与每日时间表，尝试严格执行以证明自己能胜任
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管我怎么计划，都not够，最终会失败。

special_situations.event: 与在读Student谈论大学课程的强度与作业量
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' difficult experiences foretell I will meet the same failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少向亲友表达Anxiety以避免“拖累他们”，尽量独自消化
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都觉得很难，我也必然撑not住。

special_situations.event: When considering adopting a daily schedule and trying a one-week behavioral experiment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完全坚持计划，就说明我not适应University student活
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在行动前反复Self-doubt，降低对外部支持的寻求
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 即使坚持一周也not什么用，终究还是跟not上。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be competent and maintain excellent performance; to gain peace of mind and recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fears failing at university and being crushed by pressure, disappointing oneself and others
defense_goal: 通过周密计划与自我控制来降低not确定性
避免向家人表达Anxiety以免负担他们

object_relations.self_representation: A learner who worries about failure and needs to prove one's own competence
object_relations.object_representation: 在读Student与大学环境被视为苛刻的要求者/评判者

object_relations.self_representation: not愿麻烦他人的犹疑求助者
object_relations.object_representation: Brothers seen as supportive others who may be burdened by my emotions

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to consider positive outcomes or make small-step attempts (such as sticking to a one-week schedule)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将建议理解为必须“完美坚持”才算胜任，担心努力也not会足够
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以谨慎、保留的语气回应，用“也许/not确定”弱化承诺，强调计划可能not足。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当想到向兄弟或朋友表达大学Anxiety、寻求支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为自己的情绪会给他们造成负担，可能让他们not舒服或失望
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 回避开启相关话题，轻描淡写Anxiety感受，转而自行消化。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当听到在读Student谈课程强度与大量作业时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的困难视为对自己“必然失败”的预言，为Withdrawal或not寻求支持提供理由
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调“课程非常严苛、大家都很难”的叙述，以笃定的语气为自身悲观Anticipation辩护。

manifestations: 有支持的家庭与朋友，但犹豫向他们表达Anxiety，担心给他们造成负担
倾向独自承担not确定性与压力
outcomes: 社会支持not yet被充分利用

manifestations: During the university transition, feeling an increased responsibility for choices and self-management (time management, staying excellent)
对“能否胜任”的Freedom选择伴随高度自我要求

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将“必须保持High school水平、在大学也要一样优秀”的外在要求当作自我标准
Constrains self with the inner creed 'I must stay excellent under pressure'

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the energy or requests originally meant to be directed outward, and instead directs them toward the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not愿向兄弟或朋友表达Anxiety与寻求支持，转而自我消化情绪
在Anxiety时选择独自承受而非外求帮助

contact_model.definition: 存在not良的自我Reflection与过多的自我限制和自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎，与“自主性”对应。
manifestations: 反复Self-doubt（如“我not确定能坚持”“without论怎么计划都not够”）
Holding a reserved attitude toward action and trying, lowering commitment intensity

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对被认为“强度很高”的学习任务时，来访者通常会预测自己会失败并陷入Anxiety，随后Sleep disturbance、Decreased attention。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在High school某几次项目或考试中，来访者起初认为自己without法完成或考not好，但最终坚持学习计划并顺利完成，表现Good。
exception_events.reason: not同做法：坚持并执行学习计划；not同理解：提醒自己过去曾经做得很好，从而减轻Anxiety并维持投入。

positive_force: Has had successful experiences with academic tasks in the past, able to complete high-demand tasks through planning and persistence
Has supportive family and friends who can be resources
Has awareness of time management and study planning
Willing to try small-step actions (such as first sticking to a daily schedule for a week)
negative_force: A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future
Overgeneralizes others' difficulties into own failure
Hesitates to seek support, worries about burdening others
Sleep disturbance与Decreased attention维持问题循环
对自我效能缺乏信心、倾向Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: 对大学学业的Persistent anxiety与灾难化预测
antecedent: Thinking about the university workload (reading and assignments)
与在读Student交流其课程强度
Preparing university applications and facing pressure to improve academic performance
target_behavior.core_reason: 基于他人经验与对大学强度的灾难化认知，过度概括自己将without法胜任
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation的失败与压力，并通过计划寻求控制感

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向家人（兄弟）表达Anxiety与寻求支持
antecedent: 感到Anxiety并想到寻求帮助时
When opportunities to interact with family arise
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about burdening others, fears disappointing others
target_behavior.function: Avoiding guilt and maintaining interpersonal harmony
target_behavior.consequence: 社会支持not yet被充分利用，Loneliness感增加，Anxiety得以维持
